notes: Character creator: play as a MetaHuman. Pause menu > CHARACTER: pick one of 8 bases, shape the face (23 sliders: jaw, chin, cheekbones, brow, eyes, nose, mouth, ears) and body (height, build, shoulders, head, legs, arms, torso, neck), pick hair, brows, beard and moustache (about 32 styles fitted to every face) and dye the hair. Your look is saved with your profile and seen by other players online. Walk, run, idle and jump carry over to the new body.
